label: Messages

steps.description: Decides whether the message is a transaction.

adapters.label: Decisions model classifier

adapters.label: Keyword Rules
adapters.description: Looks for words like 'debited' and 'spent'. No AI.

steps.label: Extract
steps.description: Reads the amount, merchant, account and date.

steps.description: Checks the extracted details against the email.

adapters.label: Decision model
adapters.description: A fast model that is extremely cheap

steps.label: Look up
steps.description: Finds the payee and category from merchants you've had before.

adapters.label: Known merchants
adapters.description: Matches the merchant against ones this budget has seen. A new merchant goes on to Predict.

steps.label: Predict
steps.description: Picks a payee and category when nothing matched.

steps.label: Create
steps.description: Adds the transaction to your budget, skipping duplicates.
